title: Record slow successful control-surface calls in the diagnostics log, as MCP slow calls already are
outcome: Record slow successful control-surface calls in the diagnostics log, as MCP slow calls already are
acceptance: A control-surface frame (for example turn_evaluate or turn_begin) that succeeds after more than the slow-call threshold writes one diagnostics record with its operation, total and handler time, frame sequence, and the time spent waiting for and holding the store write transaction
A control frame under the threshold writes no record, and fault records are unchanged
Tests cover a slow successful control frame, a fast one, and a slow refused one

completion.summary: Slow successful control-surface frames now write one diagnostics record with operation, total/handler time, frame sequence and write-transaction wait/hold; fast frames stay silent and fault records are unchanged. Landed at 5160c093 (ancestor of e7426a6) and verified on the Windows B gate bundle test-fdd408e3. An independent acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria (record 24d85af34b354d7291af0861d612b37b).
